parks.name: North Mole State Historic Site
parks.notes: Activation point is adjacent to the lighthouse.

parks.name: Museum of the Arts Fremantle National Heritage Site
parks.notes: Activation is within the grounds of the museum, or within 30 metres of the boundary.

parks.name: St Patrick's Basilica National Heritage Site
parks.notes: This is an active religious site. You may not be permitted to activate with ground-penetrating mast or attachments, or on certain days. Contacts for the site are available through the web site.

parks.name: Fremantle Boys School ( former ) National Heritage Site
parks.notes: Activation within 30 metres of the building. The park to the south of the building would be ideal for small portable activation.

parks.name: Marmion Memorial and Proclamation tree National Heritage Site
parks.notes: This site is on a traffic island. There is no safe place to park on the island. Activation should be with small portable or self-contained radio. There is no safe way to set up a mast of any kind.

parks.name: St John Anglican Church National Heritage Site
parks.notes: Activation is anywhere within the park area around the church building. There may be no option to penetrate the soil to secure a mast. Be aware of heavy pedestrian traffic.

parks.name: North Fremantle Town Hall National Heritage Site
parks.notes: The North Fremantle town hall activation includes the park area to the south-west. This is also a heritage area for the North Fremantle War Memorial, so a 2-fer.

parks.name: North Fremantle War Memorial National Heritage Site
parks.notes: This site is a 2-fer with the adjacent town hall. Be respectful of the memorial itself. Activation can be within 30 metres of the memorial in adjacent parking bays.

parks.name: Dingo Flour National Heritage Site
parks.notes: Activation is anywhere on the grounds of the mill. The most obvious spot is to the north where there is open ground outside the security fence. It may not be appropriate to erect masts that require ground penetration.

parks.name: Leighton Battery National Heritage Site
parks.notes: The activation site is the gun emplacements and the area surrounding it. There is a short walk from the carpark off Boundary road up to the emplacement.

parks.name: Wearne Hostel National Heritage Site
parks.notes: Wearne hostel is the old building with peaked roof. There is a park area between it and the main road along the beach where pedestrian activation in the park is possible.

parks.name: Sea View Golf Club National Heritage Site
parks.notes: Activation can be anywhere on the grounds or carparks of the golf club.

parks.name: Freshwater Bay Boat Sheds National Heritage Area
parks.notes: The activation zone is the boat sheds, and the foreshore between the two boatshed walkways.

parks.name: Jabe Dodd Flora and Fauna Reserve
Eucla Telegraph Station National Historic Site
Eucla Historic Jetty National Historic Site
parks.notes: Important note : It has been reported that the access track is by 4x4 ONLY and has some deep sand. It is also a walk from the nearest track over the dunes to the jetty.

parks.name: Norseman Post Office National Historic Site
parks.notes: Activation can be from the parking bays on either Ramsay or Prinsep streets adjacent to the Post Office.

parks.name: Wireless Hill National Heritage Site
parks.notes: Activation can be anywhere in the park. WA heritage listed site id#3518

parks.name: Round House Historic Site
parks.notes: Pedestrian activation only. Activation can be from in our around the round house.

parks.name: Tweed (WA) National Wild and Scenic River
parks.notes: Tweed river mouth is at the Blackwood river, and it extends will into Chowerup area. Activation is within 30 metres of the high water mark.

parks.name: Ludlow National Wild and Scenic River
parks.notes: Activation is at any point along the length of the river, within 30 metres of the high water mark.

parks.name: Boyup Brook Historic Flax Mill National Heritage Site
parks.notes: Once you drive in over the bridge, the entire area is part of the Flax Mill site.

parks.name: Skeleton Bridge State Historic Site
parks.notes: 5.9km return walk to the bridge along the old rail line. Watch out for snakes in summer months. The shelter is the obvious place to set up.

parks.name: Boyup Brook Agricultural Hall Historic Site
parks.notes: There is a great spot under the shelter to the East of the main building. Beware of overhead power lines.

parks.name: Sandakan Memorial Historic Site
parks.notes: Ideally this is a pedestrian activation site, but the whole park is dedicated to the Historic Sandakan death march victims.

parks.name: Avon (WA) National Wild and Scenic River
parks.notes: The activation area is 30 metres from the high tide mark. The Avon River can be activated from anywhere along its length from Walyunga National park to Boyermucking reserve

parks.name: Connor's Mill Historic Site
parks.notes: Activation can be from anywhere on the site.

parks.name: Tone National Wild and Scenic River
